dossier_meta.catalog_title: Informal question on Behrend-style sets avoiding affine patterns with mixed-sign coefficients
dossier_meta.statement_text: We do not know if there are subsets of $[N]$, in the style of Behrend's construction, with $N^{1-o(1)}$ elements avoiding such patterns (e.g., $2x + 2y = 3w + z$).
dossier_meta.context_text: In Section 3.1, the authors discuss why the Ruzsa–Bergelson–Host–Kra approach for constructing popular-difference counterexamples fails for certain linear identities $a_1P(b_1)+\cdots+a_4P(b_4)=0$ in which there are two positive and two negative $a_i$'s (rather than the symmetric case). They note that it is unknown whether large Behrend-style sets avoiding such patterns exist.
